body: ci.yml runs on push to main, pull_request and workflow_dispatch, so agent-ci (which pushes and waits for a push run) times out with exit 2 on feat/* branches. The drive for 4632d9 had to run 'gh workflow run CI --ref <branch>' by hand. Either let agent-ci dispatch the workflow, or add a branch push trigger.
title: agent-ci finds no run on a work branch
